subject: Procedure division structure
notes: §14.2.2 SR12 (cite.py --check 14.2.2 "Format 3 may be specified in a source element if and only if that source element is a factory definition, an instance definition, or an interface definition, but not in a method definition" -> OK §14.2.2 12)). Structural: Format 3 (PROCEDURE DIVISION. methodDefinition*) exists only in the CobolOO.g4 FACTORY / OBJECT / INTERFACE productions; a method's procedureDivision is the Format 1/2 rule. Probes: a METHOD-ID nested inside a method's PD (b2/sr12_nested_method.cob) and inside a PROGRAM's PD (b2/sr12_prog_method.cob) are both refused (COBOL0001 parse errors - loud, though not a rule-naming diagnostic). Interface/object Format 3 accepted (b5/gr2_oo.cob, b2/sr13_ifacestmts.cob).
